demo-jibek-ashkana.author: Aibek T.
demo-jibek-ashkana.text: Best lagman near the market, hand-pulled while you wait. Go before 1 pm or the manty are gone.

reply.text: Thank you! Plov is on Thursdays and Fridays from 11.

demo-jibek-ashkana.author: Нурия К.
demo-jibek-ashkana.text: Вкусно и недорого, но в обед очень шумно и не хватает мест.

demo-jibek-ashkana.author: Bakyt
demo-jibek-ashkana.text: Lagman abdan daamduu, baası arzan. Juma künü paloo bar.

demo-jibek-ashkana.author: Gulnara S.
demo-jibek-ashkana.text: Food is fine but they only take cash or Attelkom Pay, and the Attelkom Pay terminal was down.

demo-kalan-chaikhana.author: Daniyar
demo-kalan-chaikhana.text: Sit on the topchan, order a pot of green tea and samsa straight from the tandyr. Feels like 1975 in the best way.

demo-kalan-chaikhana.author: Марат
demo-kalan-chaikhana.text: Атмосфера отличная, шашлык хороший. Туалет во дворе базара.

demo-altyn-coffee.author: Elena V.
demo-altyn-coffee.text: Good flat white, reliable Wi-Fi, too many people on laptops at lunch.

demo-altyn-coffee.author: Timur
demo-altyn-coffee.text: Overpriced for Talas. 450 som for a cake.

reply.text: We use imported ingredients. Try our lunch set from 12 to 15.

demo-altyn-coffee.author: Айгерим
demo-altyn-coffee.text: Лучшие десерты в городе, уютный второй этаж.
